# #23 — feat: add session dedup or upsert behavior for session_save

State: CLOSED

Updated: 2026-04-28T19:41:59Z

---

## Problem
Session auto-saves create massive duplication. One session ID (678d4a62) generated 70+ identical Session end capture entries. The sessions table had 400+ entries with only ~30 containing unique information.

## Proposed Solutions

### Option A: Upsert on session_save
When saving with same session ID, UPDATE existing entry instead of INSERT. Prevents duplication at source.

### Option B: deduplicate_sessions MCP tool  
Find entries with identical content prefixes, keep most recent, archive rest.

### Option C: Auto-dedup on write
Check for existing entry with same content before inserting.

## Context
During dream cycle 2026-04-09, manually cold'd 200+ duplicate session entries across 3 pagination batches. Unsustainable manually.
